critique: The synthwave highway, pixel title, neon notes, and sunset establish a committed rhythm-game identity. Still, the four lanes are visually similar and the large title and highway compete as separate poster-like focal moments instead of one authored performance scene.
suggestion: Tie each lane to a distinct instrument or dance cue through restrained symbols and note behaviors, integrate the title rhythmically with the highway perspective, and add one signature hit-line burst or dancer silhouette that makes this game recognizable beyond standard synthwave conventions.
audit_note: Direct Codex critic output grounded in the shared r0 screenshot; not an API raw-response object.
